THE MEN BEHIND THE TROPHIES — J. SAWYER
FROM 'The Belgravian' 25 years ago ..... and 40 years ago

mentions.note: walker, aged 73½; joined January 1924; won the Police Barking to Southend Walk eight times 1924/39; 1st Norwich to Ipswich 42 miles 1930 in 7:11:48; 1st Guildford Cup 50 kilos 1931 and 1933; National 50 kilos winning team 1934/5/6/8
3rd in 1937 Brighton, 8:25:02; led Club to team victory; team scorer 1929, 1932, 1937
celebrated 80th birthday; walker, Club Champion many times over 20 miles; won the Police Barking to Southend Walk 1924, 25, 26, 30, 32, 33, 35 and 39; placed in R.W.A. Championships
member who used the old Battersea Park track (three laps to the mile); address given as Crowborough, Sussex
in Blackstaffe & Murphy Shield races group photo, 1914
63 years membership by end of 1987, aged 89; walker, won Police Long Distance Championship (Barking to Southend) 7 times 1924-1936; in Belgrave's winning RWA 20 miles and 50 kms teams up to 1939
race walker, member nearly 65 years; won Police Barking to Southend Walk eight times (1924-39); 2nd RWA 20 miles 1934, 3rd 50 Kilos 1934; won Club 20 miles Championship several times
